title: Understanding ROC Curves
text: The ROC curve is a graphical representation of the true positive rate (TPR) against the false positive rate (FPR) at various threshold settings. It helps to visualize the performance of a binary classifier.

title: Calculating TPR
text: The true positive rate (TPR) is calculated as the number of true positives divided by the sum of true positives and false negatives. Think about how this relates to the variables a and $$d$$ in the pseudocode.
